outcome: Success rate of preterm induction of labor
Factors associated with successful vaginal delivery
cohort: Live singletons undergoing an indicated induction of labor between 23 and 34 0/7 weeks from 2011 through 2015
finding: A prediction model including gestational age, simplified Bishop score, suspected intrauterine growth retardation, chronic hypertension, and body mass index was developed to accurately predict the success of labor induction in preterm patients.
